name: Temple Foyer
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: Bright lamps line the walls, illuminating every dark corner here.
desc4: Racks and shelves line the walls, for people to leave dirty cloaks or
desc5: clothing. To the east are the Temple's ornate doors, propped open even
desc6: in these uncertain times, and to the west, a wide passageway leads
desc7: towards the inner parts of the Temple.
